notes.title: LIU Patch Notes for 1.07
notes.notes:
* Manual remapping is now possible.
* Remapping will generate a save that will persist through sessions.
* Force feedback has been removed from the debug
* Mouse debug has been removed from debug
* Inverse Axis has been removed from debug

notes.title: LIU Update 1.06
notes.notes:
* OWL has been updated from v0.75.140 to v0.75.141
* Fixed a bug where copying the buttons after selecting an image would cause a crash. This is because there was some left over code that attempted to login twice after copying. This has been fixed.

notes.title: The Koko Fix
notes.notes:
* Remapped the default buttons of the mayflash controller
* This is only a temporary fix and a more robust remapping solution will need to be developed.
Does not affect any other of the branded stick layouts so far.

notes.title: Quick Fix for Nov 8
notes.notes:
Any controller named 'Unknown' that the the controller API doesn't recognize will no longer have any hard coded mappings to it.
This is to allow users to assign their own mappings should the need arise.

notes.title: Update for Nov 8 - Licenses should be sorted now!
notes.notes:
* Added in hitbox layout
* More licenses have been added from 100 to 200
* OWL has been upgraded v0.75.138 to v0.75.140 (The licenses should work now, which means no login required)

notes.title: Update notes for 6th Nov 2022
notes.notes:
Added in code to force the application license to call and circumvent the page login
Seperated a depot for the extra add on install files + sample layouts
Added in a premade layout for hitbox
